newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Eterindo rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Eterindo rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesian chemical company PT Eterindo Wahanatama recorded modest gains on its debut on Friday.
At 0250 GMT, Eterindo was the most active stock with about 10 million shares changing hands at a price of 1,425 rupiah, compared with its offering price of 1,300 rupiah.
Eterindo was also traded on the cross board with about 29 million shares changing hands.
"The listing price is not so bad .. amid weak sentiment after the index tumbled almost two percent on Thursday," a broker with a major local firm said.
But he said the upside level on Friday appeared to be limited as buying interest on the stock was modest.
"The company's fundamentals are so-so, I don't expect any surprise today," another local broker said.

He added that the timing of the listing was not good for Eterindo, as concerns over the May 29 general election coupled with the spill-over effect from a steep fall in the Thai market had affected local sentiment.
But brokers believed the share would hover around 1,400 rupiah as support from the issuer and underwriters was seen to be relatively stable.
The company floated 170 million shares and expected to raise $100 million from its initial public offering.
It has said the proceeds will be used for expansion of operations.
